observation: Twenty payment, card, coverage, reservation and refund journeys reached the deliberately wrong booking classifier, violating the immediate actual-HTTP assertion. Later assertions in those journeys were not reached.
qualification: Five current/revoked/missing approved-price cases passed. The denial case failed during setup because its paraphrase was not a literal cue and the fixture classified it as booking; setup was corrected to the existing explicit denial cue. Six more journeys were added after baseline.
limits: Synthetic signed ingress/provider/mail only; no live financial integration, carrier, mail or real-model pass.
